rows.jyutping: m4 gei3 dak1 baai2 zo2 hai2 bin1
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that you put an item somewhere and no longer remember where.

example.english: I often misplace my keys and end up searching everywhere.
example.traditional: 我成日唔記得擺咗把鎖匙喺邊，搞到周圍搵。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 baai2 zo2 baa2 so2 si4 hai2 bin1 gaau2 dou3 zau1 wai4 wan2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the item was put in an incorrect location.

example.english: I misplace the document by putting it in the wrong place, and only find it again after searching all afternoon.
example.traditional: 我一時大意將份文件擺錯地方，成個下晝先搵返。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 si4 daai6 ji3 zoeng1 fan6 man4 gin6 baai2 co3 dei6 fong1 sing4 go3 haa6 zau3 sin1 wan2 faan1
